vcal.title: Calendar

vcal.doneError: That couldn't be saved right now.

empty.title: Nothing planned – a calm day 🌿

subscribe.title: Show in my calendar app
subscribe.intro: Subscribe to your Vitanaland calendar in Apple, Google or Outlook. New entries show up there on their own.
subscribe.privacy: The link shows only titles, times and places – no details. Anyone with the link can see these entries, so keep it to yourself.
subscribe.replaceHint: A new link replaces the old one – the old one stops working.
subscribe.onlyOnce: You only see this link now. Copy it or open it straight in your calendar app.
subscribe.copyError: Copying didn't work – select the link and copy it yourself.
subscribe.activeSince: A link has been active since {date}.
subscribe.error: That didn't work just now. Please try again in a moment.
